description: KFLT v1 frozen golden vector for @forgesworn/tessera-kit. UNSIGNED serializeFilter output (signer[32,64) + sig[64,128) regions are zero — Schnorr signing is non-deterministic and has its own tests). Determinism via padToBucket:false (no random decoys). Cross-impl / future-Rust-port contract: rebuilding the Binary Fuse 16 filter from memberKeysHex + opts and serializing MUST reproduce serializedBlobHex byte-for-byte, and the membership results MUST match. All memberKeysHex entries are exactly 64 lowercase hex chars (32 bytes) — buildMembershipFilter validates every input key against /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i and throws (naming the offending index) on anything else, so a non-64-hex key can no longer appear in a filter at all (audit fix; the earlier version of this vector intentionally froze two 66-char keys before that validation existed).
